comment: Signing in with a one-time code sent to the account's email (src/sign-in-email.mjs). every code goes out through Trillion's one sender (src/mail-sender.mjs sendMail, from src/mail-settings.json); code_digits, code_minutes and tries_per_code shape one code; asking again within resend_after_minutes of a code that still works sends nothing, so the code already in the inbox keeps working; sends limits how many codes one email, and one network address, may ask for within window_minutes. words are everything a person reads.

words.subject: Your Trillion sign-in code: {code}
words.sent: If this email has a Trillion account, a {digits}-digit code is on its way. It works for {minutes} minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
words.not_an_email: Type the email address your Trillion account uses.
words.too_many_sends: Too many codes were asked for. Wait {minutes} minutes, then try again.
words.wrong_code: That code is not right, or it has ended. Check the newest email from Trillion, or send a new code.
words.no_account: That code is not right, or it has ended. Check the newest email from Trillion, or send a new code.
words.confirm_subject: Your Trillion code to add this email: {code}
words.confirm_sent: A {digits}-digit code is on its way. It works for {minutes} minutes. Check your spam folder if it does not arrive.
words.confirmed: Added. You can now sign in with a code sent to {email}.
words.signed_out: You are signed out. Sign in again, then add your email.
words.not_sent: The email could not be sent just now, so no code is on its way. Try again in a minute.
